description: Source code for EEPROM driver supporting Atmel AT24 I2C and AT25 SPI EEPROMs in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, read/write operations, and device initialization.

methods.name: eeprom_at2x_init
methods.description: Initializes the EEPROM device, configures GPIOs if present, and sets up mutex lock.

methods.name: eeprom_at2x_read
methods.description: Reads data from EEPROM, handling boundary checks and locking.

methods.name: eeprom_at2x_write
methods.description: Writes data to EEPROM, managing page boundaries, write enable/disable, and locking.

methods.name: eeprom_at2x_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the EEPROM device.
